t: A fast, secure STM32 chip family with Ethernet and plenty of memory.
steps: Buy a NUCLEO-H563ZI from Future Electronics or the ST eStore for about 30 to 44 US dollars.
Add the STM32duino board package in the Boards Manager.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Pick the Nucleo-144 board and the H563ZI chip in the Tools menu.
Upload the Blink example and watch the light flash.
Try MicroPython on the same board for live coding over USB.
Leave TrustZone switched off until you feel at home.
meta: Open Board. From $25.69. A few stores.
